arguments.subject: Payment Reminder for Invoice AC-2026-2564
arguments.body: Dear Buchhaltung Team, This is a friendly reminder that your invoice number AC-2026-2564, which was due on 12th October 2026, is now overdue. The open amount is 8160.00. Please settle this at your earliest convenience.
